## Checklist

- [ ] I searched for duplicates.
- [ ] English and Brazilian Portuguese summaries are factual and aligned.
- [ ] I inspected scripts, hooks, dependencies, and requested permissions.
- [ ] I did not present predicted regenerative benefit as a measured outcome.
- [ ] I disclosed any affiliation with this project.
- [ ] I ran `python scripts/catalog.py --write`.
- [ ] I ran `python scripts/catalog.py --check`.


## CS Navigator release/update checklist

<!-- Complete this section when the PR changes CS Navigator release bytes, metadata, bundled skills, or distribution. Otherwise mark N/A. -->

- [ ] N/A — this PR does not change a CS Navigator release/distribution surface.
- [ ] The plugin version and submission metadata are aligned.
- [ ] The exact production ZIP was rebuilt from qualified source and its SHA-256 was verified.
- [ ] The GitHub tag/release state is correct.
- [ ] Managed-workspace GitHub marketplace behavior is known: tracking `main`, synced, or intentionally pinned to a tag/SHA.
- [ ] If CS Navigator is publicly published, the **existing** public plugin received the new ZIP package version.
- [ ] Required OpenAI automated checks/review completed for the public package update.
- [ ] The approved package version was published and the public directory version was verified.
- [ ] EN and PT-BR installation/use/version documentation was updated.
- [ ] Publication evidence was recorded in the release issue.
